user_design_requirement: Independent neural network reads public problem and existing draft, models globally, predicts all modules simultaneously in one output; no optimization/repair loop in forward

model.module_attention: all valid module pairs at every layer
model.ports: all public port coordinates and full p2b weight matrix as explicit tokens; port identities preserved
model.geometry: source-draft pair geometry encoded once, no intermediate coordinate update
model.readout: one head only after final encoder layer; all modules emitted together
model.output: unbounded learned center/logaspect residual, only per-module hard-spec/area/nonnegative decoding

initialization: Warm independent attention/FFN/graph tensors from E74; zero final neural head; fresh all-corrector AdamW, E74 placer frozen
data: Frozen v5 train16k via v6 verified prefix; original dev2000/train-dev500 unchanged; not a same-data causal comparison against E85 train32k
scheduler: Warm post-training, epoch0 baseline and no protection; patience3, same four exact LR tiers, lowest tier two full epochs before stop
evaluation: Pure neural corrected draft: exact union N5, legacy pair load, overlap, compactness and public specs. Eventual reference/E74/neural corrected/separate postprocessed four-stage gallery; never attribute postprocessed legality to network.
primary_goal: draft quality first; each-dev-case N5=0; user visual comparison; Q dev500 weighted <1.01 secondary
source_comparison_limits: new full-port inputs, architecture, initialization and output freedom form a combined first candidate
new corrector16k vs historical E85 32k; no isolated global-attention causal claim
zero initialization only verifies identity, not correction quality
pure neural architecture does not mathematically guarantee N5=0
legacy_fixed_loss_for_diagnostics: First architecture study uses unchanged E85 per-source G+4I+5E+.25A in train/backward/monitor/best. Existing N5 is measured exactly as priority draft acceptance, not an unregistered new weighted Loss. Follow-up tail-objective change needs separate fixed-objective control.

objective_review.user_question: 你确定应该沿用现有Loss吗？在后处理器训练过程中还要考虑reference吗？
objective_review.decision: Do not adopt full legacy reference imitation as E86 formal objective by default. Keep the verified neural architecture; task-aligned fixed Loss design precedes training.

reference_roles.public_hard_specs: always enforced by simple per-module decode, not free-coordinate labels
reference_roles.exact_reference_centers_shapes_neighbour: propose removal from main task objective because of known current-task inconsistency
reference_roles.reference_bbox_area: optional weak global-scale supervision, separate matched ablation rather than hard optimal-area assumption
reference_roles.legacy_G: common read-only diagnostic, not a second checkpoint-selection objective

task_targets: per-module serious-overlap tail and total collision
objective_review.weights: Not registered; one training-side normalization/calibration followed by fixed weights, no dev coefficient sweep
objective_review.possible_minimal_control: Same global neural network and task objective, with/without weak reference-box supervision
